text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Uhh, what was it again? I'm pretty sure 
I spent until this morning preparing it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't just stop thinking in the 
middle of my research...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine... You're the test subject, so 
there's... no problem at all..."

Agnes Tachyon was dozing off the entire 
time. It seems she wasn't able to get much 
rest.
